Stazione - Il Prato (Santa Maria Novella) — Florence, Italy

In detail

The area around Santa Maria Novella station is consistently named across multiple 2025 press reports as Florence's most acute street-safety problem spot. It is one of the three official Prefecture 'zone rosse'. The pedestrian underpass beneath the station has been repeatedly described by local outlets as an open-air drug market ('supermercato della droga', 'il tunnel della droga') with crack use in broad daylight, and a district crime breakdown rated the immediate station area as facing simultaneous, organised North African and Central African drug-dealing groups alongside South American pickpocketing crews. Political figures across parties have publicly criticised the Comune's response as inadequate. This is a genuine, well-documented and long-running concern, worse after dark but with visible degrado during the day too. Sources checked: La Nazione, 'Santa Maria Novella, mercato nero e crack in pieno giorno'; FirenzeToday, 'Nel tunnel della droga: il sottopasso di Santa Maria Novella ormai è una piazza di spaccio'; Comune di Firenze, Lega councillor statement on the station underpass; La Firenze che Vorrei, quartiere-by-quartiere summer crime report (Quartiere 1 station-area data).
